videos.headline: Otega Oweh rocks the rim with huge poster for Kentucky
videos.description: Kentucky's Otega Oweh glides to the rack and throws down a massive poster jam.

tracking.trackingName: NCB_One-Play (Otega Oweh rocks the rim with huge poster for Kentucky) 2025/01/15 ESHEET

videos.headline: Highlight: Trio of double-digit scorers set Kentucky past Texas A&M
videos.description: Jaxson Robinson scores 22 while Andrew Carr and Otega Oweh add 13 and 11 points, respectively, as the No. 8 Wildcats outrebound the No. 11 Aggies, 40-30, in an 81-69 victory.

videos.headline: Robinson reveals key to No. 8 Kentucky's win over No. 11 Aggies
videos.description: Following his 22-point performance, transfer Jaxson Robinson emphasizes the Wildcats' focus on the board vs. Texas A&M and expresses his overwhelming appreciation for Mark Pope.
